Early morning outdoors beside a quiet first-century Judean olive garden, softly out-of-focus limestone hillside, silvery olive leaves, cool blue dawn shadows and restrained warm sunrise side light, real environment, no glow or halo. White natural linen tunic with fine warm ivory outer mantle, authentic weave and folds.
